body.prompt: Create an accessible Tabs component using CSS Modules (.module.css). MUST use named export 'export const Tabs = ...'. MUST define a TypeScript 'interface' explicitly declaring ': string' for tab IDs, ': React.ReactNode' for tab content, and explicitly include 'isDisabled?: boolean' for individual tab states. MUST support active tab handling. MUST include 'role="tablist"' on the container, and 'role="tab"', 'aria-selected', 'aria-controls', and 'tabIndex' on the individual tab buttons for keyboard navigation. MUST NOT use 'any' or inline styles. MUST include responsive styling.
